extensions.scope: Only the /cuppy route (apps/web/src/app/(cuppy)/), which has its own root layout. Not the JuiceColored portfolio. Brand assets are owner-owned (Cuppy Ice Cream); publication permission pending. See docs/cuppy/README.md.

flavorRoles.note: field and ink drive the chip and flavor band via --chip-fill/--chip-ink and --flavor-field/--flavor-ink; cream and sheen drive the 3D swirl material only.

display-word.purpose: The single full-bleed pedestal word at the hero's foot; size derived from its measured 8.27em advance so it never wraps.

display-lead.purpose: Opening phrase above the cup. Narrow screens: clamp(1.75rem, 9.6vw, 4rem).

headline.purpose: Flavor name in the flavor band.

headline-close.purpose: Closing statement on ink; accent span in lavender.

title.purpose: Stepped ritual list (1.1em indent per line) with sparkles.

wordmark.purpose: Masthead name; 1.125rem below 960px. Suffix at 0.55em, 700, 0.12em tracking.

body.purpose: Default text; pitch at clamp(1rem, 1.25vw, 1.1875rem); close copy 1.125rem, max 28ch.

label.purpose: Fieldset legend and chip names (chip names at 0.04em; 100% width and clamp(0.6875rem, 2.8vw, 0.8125rem) below 960px). Concept tag uses 0.75rem at 112%, 0.08em.

fine-print.purpose: Footer disclosure, cream at 74% alpha, max 72ch.

shadows.name: chip-selected
shadows.purpose: filter on the selected cup chip.

shadows.name: cup-contact
shadows.purpose: Two stacked ground planes under the 3D cup (soft scale 3.1, core 1.7; opacity 0.42 at rest), shrinking and fading as the cup bobs up.

motion.name: button
motion.purpose: Button lift, shadow and arrow nudge.

motion.name: chip
motion.purpose: Chip lift/select transform and shadow filter; chip sparkle opacity 0.3s, transform 0.45s.

motion.name: flavor-flood
motion.purpose: Flavor band background and text color cross-fade.

motion.name: sparkle-twinkle
motion.value: 3.2s ease-in-out infinite; scale 1 to 0.72, rotate 0 to 12deg; staggered -1.1s, -2.2s

motion.name: swirl-retint
motion.purpose: 3D cream and sheen color cross-fade on flavor change.

motion.name: swirl-squash
motion.value: 1.1s; wobble = exp(-5s) * cos(13s); scale x/z 1 + 0.06w, y 1 - 0.09w
motion.purpose: Damped squash-wobble of the swirl on flavor change.

motion.name: cup-float
motion.value: bob sin(1.15t) * 0.085; yaw sin(0.36t) * 0.42 + pointer.x * 0.45; pitch pointer.y * 0.16 + sin(0.8t) * 0.025; roll -pointer.x * 0.07 + sin(0.6t) * 0.03; pointer smoothing 1 - exp(-4dt)

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, or the in-page pause
motion.purpose: CSS: sparkle animation off (paused via toggle), chip/button/flavor transitions off. 3D: render loop stops; cup settles to rotation (0.02, 0.18, 0), y 0, scale 1, colors applied instantly. Loop also stops off-screen (120px root margin) and when the tab is hidden.

breakpoints.name: narrow
breakpoints.purpose: Hero stops filling the viewport; chips become a 3-across row under the word; grids collapse to one column.

breakpoints.name: compact
breakpoints.purpose: Motion toggle icon-only (label visually hidden), wordmark suffix hidden, smaller concept tag.

focus.chip: outline: 3px solid #17131A; outline-offset: 5px; border-radius: 12px (on the label via :has(input:focus-visible))
focus.on-ink: cream button switches its outline color to #F2E6D2

camera.framing: product fills ~72% of stage height or 78% of width on narrow stages; ground line near the stage bottom

lights.name: key
lights.purpose: Warm window key from upper left.

materials.name: label-paper
materials.map: canvas label: ink #17131A on paper #F2E6D2; pixel sunglasses, CUPPY, ICE CREAM band with sparkles

materials.name: drip-cream
materials.note: clone of cream without vertex colors; three drips at angles 0.6, -2.1, 2.45 rad, lengths 0.46, 0.24, 0.32

object3d.fallback: WebP still of the same model and camera (apps/web/public/cuppy/poster-<flavor>.webp, 720x1068) shown until live and on WebGL absence or context loss (up to 2 restarts).

place-items: center; width: 11.5rem; aspect-ratio: 168 / 112; color: var(--chip-ink); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-chip input { position: absolute; right: 0.35rem; width: 1.5rem; fill: #17131A; opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.4) rotate(-30deg); transition: opacity 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), transform 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-chip:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); } .ds-chip:has(input:checked) { transform: translateX(-0.6rem) scale(1.04); } .ds-chip:has(input:checked) .ds-chip-cup { stroke-width: 4.5; filter: drop-shadow(0 14px 14px rgb(58 34 64 / 0.32)); } .ds-chip:has(input:checked) .ds-chip-sparkle { opacity: 1; components.name: Flavor Band
components.description: Full-bleed section that takes the selected flavor's field and ink, with the stepped ritual list.
components.html:
Chocolate

Dark, deep, a little dramatic. Every lift leaves a ribbon behind.

  1. Dig in.
  2. Lift slow.
  3. Let it stretch.
components.css: .ds-band { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.15fr) minmax(0, 1fr); align-items: end; gap: clamp(2rem, 5vw, 5rem); padding: clamp(4rem, 9vw, 7.5rem) clamp(1rem, 3.2vw, 2.75rem); background: var(--flavor-field); color: var(--flavor-ink); font-family: Archivo, 'Arial Narrow', Arial, sans-serif; transition: background-color 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), color 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-band-copy { display: grid; gap: 1.5rem; } .ds-band h2 { margin: 0; font-size: clamp(2.75rem, 8.4vw, 7.5rem); font-weight: 900; font-stretch: 125%; letter-spacing: -0.03em; line-height: 0.88; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-band-copy p { margin: 0; max-width: 30ch; font-size: clamp(1.125rem, 1.7vw, 1.5rem); line-height: 1.4; } .ds-ritual { display: grid; gap: 0.2em; margin: 0; padding: 0; font-size: clamp(1.75rem, 3.6vw, 3.25rem); font-weight: 800; font-stretch: 112%; letter-spacing: -0.015em; line-height: 1.05; list-style: none; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-ritual li { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.35em; } .ds-ritual li:nth-child(2) { padding-left: 1.1em; } .ds-ritual li:nth-child(3) { padding-left: 2.2em; } .ds-ritual svg { flex: none; width: 0.6em; fill: currentColor; } @media (max-width: 959px) { .ds-band { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); } }

components.name: Sparkle
components.description: Ink four-point sparkle, the world's only ornament; twinkles on the hero, static elsewhere.
components.css: .ds-sparkles { display: flex; gap: 24px; align-items: center; padding: 24px; background: #C397C4; } .ds-sparkle { width: 2.5rem; fill: #17131A; animation: ds-twinkle 3.2s ease-in-out infinite; } .ds-sparkle-b { width: 1.5rem; animation-delay: -1.1s; } @keyframes ds-twinkle { 0%, 100% { transform: scale(1) rotate(0deg); } 50% { transform: scale(0.72) rotate(12deg); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-sparkle { animation: none; } }

narrative.overview:
A drenched lavender ground carries ink type so wide and heavy that it reads as a printed cup band. The product does not sit beside the copy; a real 3D soft-serve cup floats inside the sentence, between the lead line and a full-bleed pedestal word, and its soft plum contact shadow lands on the letters below it. Everything else (pitch, CTA, flavor chips) is small, quiet, and pinned to the edges so the cup and the word own the first viewport.

Density is low and the voice is loud only at display size. Color is the brand's own: lavender as the field, ink for type, outlines and buttons, cream only where it can be read (on ink or chocolate). Chocolate and caramel are not accents; they are whole fields that the page floods into when a flavor is picked. Ink four-point sparkles are the world's ornament and appear on the page, the chips, the ritual list and the printed cup label.

Motion is soft and physical, and the signature moment is the pull, driven by the page's own scroll: a spoon lifts the real top of the swirl and stays where it was in the document while the cup travels down with the reader, so a continuous ribbon of cream stretches the length of the page and reassembles on the way back. Around it: a slow bob and pointer tilt at rest, a cubic ease-out (`cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)`) on every UI transition, and a damped squash-wobble re-tint on a flavor change. Reduced motion gets one composed 3D still instead of the scroll scene. (The flavor-band component snippet below predates the flavor panel; DESIGN.md describes the current panel.)
keyCharacteristics: Lavender field, ink type, cream only on dark fields.
Archivo at 125% width, weight 900, uppercase, tight negative tracking for display.
The 3D cup sits in the headline, not beside it.
Cup-silhouette flavor chips with ink outlines.
Ink four-point sparkles as the only ornament.
Flavor choice re-tints the object and floods the next section.

rules.name: The Cream Stays Off Lavender Rule
rules.body: Cream text on lavender measures about 2:1 and is never used. Cream type appears only on ink or chocolate; on lavender, cream, and caramel the text is ink.

rules.name: The Flavor Is a Field Rule
rules.body: Flavor colors arrive as full-width fields and chip fills, each paired with its contrast ink (vanilla: ink, chocolate: cream, caramel: ink). They are not sprinkled as accents on the lavender hero.

rules.name: The Width Is the Voice Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy is carried by the width axis and weight, not by switching families: 125% for display, 112–118% for labels and buttons, 100% for reading text. Uppercase is reserved for widened text; body copy is never uppercase.

rules.name: The Tight Display Rule
rules.body: Display sizes always take negative tracking (-0.01em to -0.03em) and line-height under 0.92; tracked-out uppercase is for small labels only.

rules.name: The Soft Tint Rule
rules.body: Shadows are blurred, offset downward, and tinted ink or plum. The cream button on ink takes no shadow.

dos: Do set every display line in Archivo at 125% width, weight 900, uppercase, with negative tracking.
Do pair each flavor field with its measured contrast ink: cream on chocolate, ink on vanilla and caramel.
Do keep the product inside the headline composition, with its contact shadow landing on the type.
Do use the ink four-point sparkle as the ornament, in ink or `currentColor`.
Do run every UI transition on `cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)` and drop it under `prefers-reduced-motion`; give the 3D object a composed still pose, not a frozen frame.
Do keep a still render of the same model behind the live canvas so the object never disappears.
Do keep the "Internal concept" tag and the footer disclosure on any page in this world until publication permission is granted.
donts: Don't set cream text on lavender (about 2:1).
Don't split the hero into copy left and product right with a badge row; the cup lives in the sentence.
Don't use grey or neutral black shadows; tint them ink or plum.
Don't apply these tokens to the JuiceColored portfolio routes.
Don't use Cuppy's logo or mascot artwork, or the site's display face, in the build; they are reference only.
